description: Uzay keşfine, bilime ve teknolojiye ilgi duyuyorum. Bu projeyi, NASA'nın robotik görevlerinin tarihini ve başarılarını ilgi çekici ve eğitici bir şekilde keşfetmek amacıyla hazırladım. Bilimsel araştırmayı, yaratıcılığı ve hikâye anlatımını bir araya getirerek uzay keşfini okuyucular için daha anlaşılır ve ilginç hâle getirmeyi hedefledim. Bu proje, merakımı, özverimi ve evreni öğrenmeye olan ilgimi yansıtmaktadır.
summary:
After the Mission is an educational space exploration project that brings the stories of three important space missions to life: Surveyor 3, Opportunity, and InSight. Through illustrated comics, historical information, an interactive exploration map, and NASA scientific data, the project presents the achievements and discoveries of these missions in an engaging and accessible way.

It explores Surveyor 3's contributions to lunar exploration, Opportunity's remarkable journey across Mars that lasted nearly 15 years, and InSight's research into the planet's interior and seismic activity. By combining storytelling with scientifically accurate information, the project aims to make space exploration easier to understand and highlight the lasting impact of these missions on our knowledge of the Solar System.
details:
After the Mission is an interactive digital storybook that introduces three important space missions: Surveyor 3, Opportunity, and InSight. The project combines creative storytelling, illustrated comic-style pages, historical facts, NASA scientific data, and mission images to make space exploration engaging and understandable.

Each mission is presented through a narrative approach, allowing readers to discover the spacecraft's journey, challenges, scientific discoveries, and contributions to space exploration. The content is supported by real mission information and reliable NASA sources to ensure scientific accuracy.

The project aims to make complex scientific information accessible to a wider audience, especially young readers, while encouraging curiosity about space science and planetary exploration.

The digital book was designed using Canva and published through Heyzine to provide an accessible reading experience. No custom hardware or programming languages were required.

Its creative approach lies in transforming real scientific missions into engaging stories without losing their historical and scientific accuracy. Visual design, readability, factual reliability, and educational value were considered throughout the development process.
